overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the two selectmen's communication about postponing the Temple parking lot discussion did not involve a quorum. The AG declined to review the Town Manager individually and the public records request, and ordered no remedy.

allegations.summary: Alleged the Board deliberated outside a posted meeting about postponing discussion of a Temple parking lot application between May 29 and August 7, 2012.
allegations.key_passage: Accordingly, because the communication was not between or among a quorum of the body, we find that the Board did not violate the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Alleged the Town Manager violated the Open Meeting Law in connection with the same postponement; the AG declined to review the individual.
allegations.key_passage: Mr. Lemnios is an individual public employee who is not a member of a public body, thus he was not required to comply with the Open Meeting Law and could not have violated it.

allegations.summary: The complainant also submitted a public records request with the complaint, which the AG declined to review under the Public Records Law.
allegations.key_passage: Because this request relates to the requirements of the Public Records Law, we decline to review it, and refer Ms. Kaplan to the Supervisor of Records in the Secretary of the Commonwealth's Public Records Division.
